main_text.p: Nos, inquiunt, qui in his Sarmaticis regionibus gregem Christi pasci-mus, quamvis diversos præceptores in perdiscenda unâ eademq; cœlesti doctrinâ habuerimus, alii Augustanæ, alii Bohemicæ, alii Helveticæ confessioni ritibúsq; assuefacti & addicti, quum aliquâ-diu sibimet quisq; in suo sensu placentes invicem contenderimus, &nō illepidū Antichristo spectaculum præbuerimus: tandem tum aucto[?]-ritate Spiritus S. pacem, concordi-am & amorem mutuum suadentis, tum etiam malis discordiæ per-moti, omnibus litibus finem impo-suimus, ac contendere jam in more non habemus. Cui cōcordiæ [NB] & amori mutuo Dominus ita be-nedicit, ut lætitiam ac fructum inde sequentem vix verbis satis declara-re possimus: nam non solùm illum illud in nostris conscientiis senti-mus; Ecce quàm bonum & jucun-dum fratres habitare in unum: sed etiam manifestè experimur, id ec-

page.notes: The words "Nos" and "tandem" are read as printed; the first line has no clear paragraph indent, so the page is kept as one paragraph beginning here. "aucto" in "aucto-ritate" is a doubtful letter form and is marked [?]. "[NB]" stands inside the text column, so it is kept as text, not as a note. The left edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
